Name: TownLedger
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
Description
Town Ledger turns Stardew Valley's town-wide prestige into a spendable strategic resource. Quests, gifts, festivals, hearts, and bundles earn prestige; spend it at the Town Hall on community projects, permanent shop discounts, study trips, or a feast for the whole town. Every purchase costs specific villagers friendship, forcing a choice between being liked and getting things done.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you are on [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and have [b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Download either the Chinese package (TownLedger-x.x.x-zh.zip) or the English package (TownLedger-x.x.x-en.zip). Both contain the same code; [b]do not install both[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the TownLedger
 folder into: Stardew Valley/Mods/[/*]
[*]If an old Mods/TownPrestige. folder exists, delete it to avoid loading two copies.[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to change the hotkey, multipliers, and prices in game.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, load a save, read Lewis's letter, and press [b]F7[/b] to open the Town Hall.[/*]
[/list]Existing saves are supported. On first install, a one-time legacy grant is added based on hearts and bundles (up to 300). Back up your save before installing.
Main features
[list]
[*][b]Earn prestige[/b]: loved/liked/neutral gifts +15/+9/+5; daily quest +12; story quest +18; special order +45; each new heart +3; festival +18; bundle +38; meeting a new villager +3.[/*]
[*][b]Six community projects[/b]: repair the greenhouse, quarry bridge, glittering boulder, minecarts, bulletin board, and desert bus directly with prestige for 2250/1800/1800/1950/2100/3000. Each is permanent.[/*]
[*][b]Permanent shop discounts[/b]: 11 permanent shops (Pierre's, Joja, Blacksmith, Carpenter, Clinic, Oasis, Saloon, Ranch, Fish Shop, Dwarf, Adventurer's Guild). Three fundraiser levels cost 100/180/280, each -10%, up to -30%.[/*]
[*][b]Study trip[/b]: spend 60 prestige to send a villager away for 7 days. The target loses 200 friendship; 28-day cooldown. Spouses, family, and children are excluded.[/*]
[*][b]Community feast[/b]: spend 160 prestige to give every known villager +30 friendship, once per season.[/*]
[*][b]Tiers and ledger[/b]: lifetime prestige 200/600/1400/2500 raises your tier; tiers never fall, and tier 4 gives -10% civic costs. The ledger records every gain and spend.[/*]
[*][b]No HUD[/b]: nothing blocks the screen; press F7 for the Town Hall. Mouse, scroll wheel, and keyboard are supported.[/*]
[*][b]SVE / RSV compatible[/b]: permanent shops and social villagers are recognized automatically; festival stalls, temporary merchants, and service counters are filtered out.[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves[/b]: add it to an existing save; the prestige ledger stays in the save if you uninstall and returns when you reinstall.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b] (required)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional, for in-game settings)[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and/or [b]Ridgeside Village[/b] (optional; install normally, they require Content Patcher)[/*]
[*]No other required dependencies[/*]
[*]Multiplayer is not host-synced yet; single-player is recommended. If a villager is on a study trip, wait for them to return before uninstalling.
Description《乡誉录》把星露谷的“小镇声望”做成一种可消耗的战略资源。完成任务、送礼、过节、提升心数、完成收集包都会积累声望；你可以用它在议事厅解锁社区项目、给商店争取永久折扣、把某位镇民送出去进修，或办一场全镇宴席。每次花费都会让具体的人付出好感代价，因此在“当好人”和“办大事”之间必须做选择。Installation instructions[/*]
[*][list=1]
[*]确认游戏为 [b]1.6.15[/b]，并安装 [b]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本[/b]。[/*]
[*]下载中文包（TownLedger-x.x.x-zh.zip）或英文包（TownLedger-x.x.x-en.zip）；两个包代码相同，[b]不要同时安装[/b]。[/*]
[*]解压后把 TownLedger文件夹放到：Stardew Valley/Mods/[/*]
[*]如果旧的 Mods/TownPrestige 还在，请删除它，避免重复加载。[/*]
[*]可选：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，在游戏内调整按键、倍率与价格。[/*]
[*]启动游戏、读档，读刘易斯寄来的信，按 [b]F7[/b] 打开小镇议事厅。[/*]
[/list]现有存档可直接使用；首次安装会按已有心数与收集包补发一笔声望（上限 300）。建议安装前备份存档。Main features[/*]
[*][list]
[*][b]声望收入[/b]：最爱/喜欢/中性礼物 +15/+9/+5；日常委托 +12；剧情任务 +18；特别命令 +45；每颗新心 +3；节日 +18；收集包 +38；认识新镇民 +3。[/*]
[*][b]六项社区项目[/b]：可直接用声望修复温室、采石场桥、闪光巨石、矿车、布告栏和沙漠巴士，价格 2250/1800/1800/1950/2100/3000，永久生效。[/*]
[*][b]永久商店折扣[/b]：11 家常驻商店（皮埃尔、Joja、铁匠铺、木工坊、医院、绿洲、酒吧、牧场、鱼店、矮人、冒险家公会），三级募捐 100/180/280，每级 -10%，最高 -30%。[/*]
[*][b]送人进修[/b]：花 60 声望让一位镇民离开 7 天，目标 -200 好感，28 天冷却；配偶、家人和孩子不可选。[/*]
[*][b]社区宴席[/b]：花 160 声望，让所有已认识镇民 +30 好感，每季一次。[/*]
[*][b]等级与账本[/b]：累计声望 200/600/1400/2500 提升等级；等级只涨不跌，满级市政花费 -10%；账本记录每一笔收入与支出。[/*]
[*][b]无 HUD[/b]：界面不挡视线，按 F7 打开议事厅；支持鼠标、滚轮和键盘。[/*]
[*][b]SVE / RSV 兼容[/b]：自动识别常驻商店与可社交镇民，过滤节日摊位、临时商人和服务柜台。[/*]
[*][b]旧存档兼容[/b]：可直接加入现有存档，卸载后声望账本留在存档里，装回继续用。[/*]
[/list]Requirements[/*]
[*][list]
[*][b]星露谷物语 1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本[/b]（必需）[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]（可选，用于游戏内设置）[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] 和/或 [b]Ridgeside Village[/b]（可选；按正常方式安装，它们依赖 Content Patcher）[/*]
[*]没有其它必需依赖[/*]
[*]多人游戏目前没有主机同步，建议单人使用；卸载前如果正在进修，建议等对方回来[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
